const BOT_IMG = "data:image/jpeg;base64,";

import { useState, useEffect, useRef, useCallback } from "react";

const C = {
  bg: "#0a0612",
  red: "#e52330",
  orange: "#e8601e",
  orangeGlow: "#ff7a33",
  magenta: "#d4145a",
  purple: "#7b2fbe",
  violet: "#9b4dff",
  cyan: "#00d4ff",
  blue: "#4488ff",
  green: "#00ff88",
  amber: "#e68a00",
  text: "#f0eee6",
  textMuted: "rgba(240,238,230,0.35)",
  textSoft: "rgba(240,238,230,0.6)",
  panel: "rgba(12, 8, 22, 0.97)",
};

/* ═══ CIRCULAR WAVE VISUALIZER — wraps around the avatar ═══ */
function CircularWave({ speaking, idle, size = 340 }) {
  const canvasRef = useRef(null);
  const animRef = useRef(null);
  const phaseRef = useRef(0);
  const ampRef = useRef(0.05);

  useEffect(() => {
    const target = speaking ? 1.0 : idle ? 0.2 : 0.05;
    const draw = () => {
      const canvas = canvasRef.current;
      if (!canvas) return;
      const ctx = canvas.getContext("2d");
      const dpr = window.devicePixelRatio || 1;
      canvas.width = size * dpr;
      canvas.height = size * dpr;
      ctx.scale(dpr, dpr);
      ctx.clearRect(0, 0, size, size);

      ampRef.current += (target - ampRef.current) * 0.045;
      const amp = ampRef.current;
      phaseRef.current += speaking ? 0.04 : 0.015;
      const phase = phaseRef.current;
      const cx = size / 2, cy = size / 2;
      const baseR = size * 0.39;

      // Multiple ring layers
      const rings = [
        { color: C.cyan, alpha: 0.6, ampMul: 1.0, freq: 8, speed: 1, width: 2.5 },
        { color: C.blue, alpha: 0.4, ampMul: 0.7, freq: 10, speed: 1.4, width: 2 },
        { color: C.violet, alpha: 0.5, ampMul: 0.85, freq: 6, speed: 0.7, width: 2.2 },
        { color: C.magenta, alpha: 0.45, ampMul: 0.6, freq: 12, speed: 1.8, width: 2 },
        { color: C.orangeGlow, alpha: 0.3, ampMul: 0.5, freq: 7, speed: 1.2, width: 1.8 },
      ];

      rings.forEach((ring) => {
        ctx.beginPath();
        const steps = 200;
        for (let i = 0; i <= steps; i++) {
          const angle = (i / steps) * Math.PI * 2;
          const wave1 = Math.sin(angle * ring.freq + phase * ring.speed) * 12;
          const wave2 = Math.sin(angle * ring.freq * 1.7 + phase * ring.speed * 0.6) * 6;
          const wave3 = Math.sin(angle * ring.freq * 0.5 + phase * ring.speed * 2) * 8;
          const noise = speaking ? (Math.random() - 0.5) * 4 : 0;
          const r = baseR + (wave1 + wave2 + wave3 + noise) * amp * ring.ampMul;
          const x = cx + Math.cos(angle) * r;
          const y = cy + Math.sin(angle) * r;
          i === 0 ? ctx.moveTo(x, y) : ctx.lineTo(x, y);
        }
        ctx.closePath();
        ctx.strokeStyle = ring.color;
        ctx.globalAlpha = ring.alpha * (0.3 + amp * 0.7);
        ctx.lineWidth = ring.width;
        ctx.shadowColor = ring.color;
        ctx.shadowBlur = speaking ? 20 : 10;
        ctx.stroke();
        ctx.shadowBlur = 0;
        ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
      });

      // Fill glow rings
      [
        { color: C.cyan, alpha: 0.04, mul: 1.0 },
        { color: C.magenta, alpha: 0.03, mul: 0.8 },
      ].forEach((fill) => {
        ctx.beginPath();
        const steps = 200;
        for (let i = 0; i <= steps; i++) {
          const angle = (i / steps) * Math.PI * 2;
          const r = baseR + Math.sin(angle * 8 + phase) * 12 * amp * fill.mul;
          const x = cx + Math.cos(angle) * r;
          const y = cy + Math.sin(angle) * r;
          i === 0 ? ctx.moveTo(x, y) : ctx.lineTo(x, y);
        }
        ctx.closePath();
        // Fill toward center
        const grad = ctx.createRadialGradient(cx, cy, baseR * 0.85, cx, cy, baseR + 20);
        grad.addColorStop(0, "transparent");
        grad.addColorStop(1, fill.color + Math.round(fill.alpha * 255).toString(16).padStart(2, "0"));
        ctx.fillStyle = grad;
        ctx.fill();
      });

      // Sparkle particles orbiting
      if (amp > 0.1) {
        const count = Math.floor(amp * 20);
        for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
          const angle = phase * 0.3 + (i / count) * Math.PI * 2;
          const dist = baseR + 15 + Math.sin(phase * 2 + i * 1.5) * 15;
          const x = cx + Math.cos(angle) * dist;
          const y = cy + Math.sin(angle) * dist;
          const a = Math.max(0, Math.sin(phase * 1.5 + i * 2.3)) * amp * 0.6;
          ctx.beginPath();
          ctx.arc(x, y, 1.5, 0, Math.PI * 2);
          ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(255,255,255,${a})`;
          ctx.fill();
        }
      }

      // Inner glow
      const ig = ctx.createRadialGradient(cx, cy, baseR * 0.7, cx, cy, baseR);
      ig.addColorStop(0, "transparent");
      ig.addColorStop(1, speaking ? "rgba(229,35,48,0.06)" : "rgba(123,47,190,0.03)");
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(cx, cy, baseR, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.fillStyle = ig;
      ctx.fill();

      animRef.current = requestAnimationFrame(draw);
    };
    animRef.current = requestAnimationFrame(draw);
    return () => cancelAnimationFrame(animRef.current);
  }, [speaking, idle, size]);

  return <canvas ref={canvasRef} style={{ width: size, height: size, position: "absolute", top: 0, left: 0, zIndex: 1 }} />;
}

/* ═══ HORIZONTAL SIRI WAVE ═══ */
function SiriWave({ active, speaking, width = 500, height = 100 }) {
  const canvasRef = useRef(null);
  const animRef = useRef(null);
  const phaseRef = useRef(0);
  const ampRef = useRef(0.05);

  useEffect(() => {
    const tgt = speaking ? 1.0 : active ? 0.3 : 0.05;
    const draw = () => {
      const canvas = canvasRef.current;
      if (!canvas) return;
      const ctx = canvas.getContext("2d");
      const dpr = window.devicePixelRatio || 1;
      canvas.width = width * dpr; canvas.height = height * dpr;
      ctx.scale(dpr, dpr); ctx.clearRect(0, 0, width, height);
      ampRef.current += (tgt - ampRef.current) * 0.05;
      const amp = ampRef.current;
      phaseRef.current += speaking ? 0.05 : active ? 0.02 : 0.008;
      const phase = phaseRef.current;
      const cx = width / 2, cy = height / 2;

      [
        { c: C.cyan, a: 0.5, f: 0.007, m: 1, s: 1, w: 2.5 },
        { c: C.blue, a: 0.4, f: 0.009, m: 0.75, s: 1.3, w: 2 },
        { c: C.violet, a: 0.4, f: 0.011, m: 0.6, s: 0.7, w: 2 },
        { c: C.magenta, a: 0.45, f: 0.008, m: 0.85, s: 1.5, w: 2.5 },
        { c: C.orangeGlow, a: 0.3, f: 0.01, m: 0.5, s: 1.1, w: 1.8 },
      ].forEach(wv => {
        ctx.beginPath();
        for (let x = 0; x <= width; x += 2) {
          const d = Math.abs(x - cx) / cx;
          const env = Math.exp(-d * d * 3);
          const y = cy + (Math.sin(x * wv.f + phase * wv.s) * 30 + Math.sin(x * wv.f * 2.1 + phase * wv.s * 0.6) * 14 + Math.sin(x * wv.f * 0.4 + phase * wv.s * 1.4) * 18 + (speaking ? (Math.random() - 0.5) * 6 : 0)) * amp * wv.m * env;
          x === 0 ? ctx.moveTo(x, y) : ctx.lineTo(x, y);
        }
        ctx.strokeStyle = wv.c; ctx.globalAlpha = wv.a * (0.3 + amp * 0.7);
        ctx.lineWidth = wv.w; ctx.shadowColor = wv.c; ctx.shadowBlur = speaking ? 16 : 6;
        ctx.stroke(); ctx.shadowBlur = 0; ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
      });
      animRef.current = requestAnimationFrame(draw);
    };
    animRef.current = requestAnimationFrame(draw);
    return () => cancelAnimationFrame(draw);
  }, [active, speaking, width, height]);

  return <canvas ref={canvasRef} style={{ width, height, display: "block" }} />;
}

/* ═══ BUBBLE ═══ */
function Bubble({ text, isBot, visible }) {
  return (
    <div style={{ display: "flex", justifyContent: isBot ? "flex-start" : "flex-end", marginBottom: 10, opacity: visible ? 1 : 0, transform: visible ? "translateY(0)" : "translateY(10px)", transition: "all 0.5s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1)" }}>
      <div style={{ maxWidth: "82%", padding: "11px 16px", borderRadius: isBot ? "4px 20px 20px 20px" : "20px 4px 20px 20px", background: isBot ? "linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(0,212,255,0.06), rgba(123,47,190,0.04))" : `linear-gradient(135deg, ${C.orange}bb, ${C.red}99)`, border: `1px solid ${isBot ? "rgba(0,212,255,0.1)" : "rgba(229,35,48,0.2)"}`, color: C.text, fontSize: 13.5, lineHeight: 1.6, fontFamily: "'DM Sans', sans-serif", backdropFilter: "blur(12px)" }}>
        {text}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

/* ═══════ MAIN ═══════ */
export default function InstaPassFinal() {
  const [mode, setMode] = useState("landing");
  const [messages, setMessages] = useState([]);
  const [input, setInput] = useState("");
  const [typing, setTyping] = useState(false);
  const [vis, setVis] = useState({});
  const endRef = useRef(null);

  useEffect(() => { endRef.current?.scrollIntoView({ behavior: "smooth" }); }, [messages, typing]);

  const startChat = () => {
    setMode("waking");
    setTimeout(() => {
      setMode("chat");
      setTyping(true);
      setTimeout(() => {
        const id = Date.now();
        setMessages([{ id, isBot: true, text: "Hey! I'm your InstaPass AI Concierge. I can find events, grab tickets, and help you discover something unforgettable. What are you in the mood for?" }]);
        setTyping(false);
        setTimeout(() => setVis(p => ({ ...p, [id]: true })), 50);
      }, 1500);
    }, 2200);
  };

  const send = () => {
    if (!input.trim()) return;
    const uid = Date.now();
    setMessages(p => [...p, { id: uid, text: input, isBot: false }]);
    setTimeout(() => setVis(p => ({ ...p, [uid]: true })), 30);
    setInput(""); setTyping(true);
    setTimeout(() => {
      const bid = Date.now();
      const r = [
        "Found 8 events near you this weekend! 🎵 3 concerts, 🎭 2 theater shows, 🏀 3 games. Want me to narrow it down?",
        "Premium seats available with InstaPass early-access pricing — I can lock those in right now before they're gone.",
        "Here's what's trending: rooftop jazz Friday, immersive art Saturday, and a sold-out comedy show I can still get you into 🔥",
        "I put together a curated weekend: two events Friday, a brunch experience Saturday, and a surprise late-night Sunday!",
      ];
      setMessages(p => [...p, { id: bid, isBot: true, text: r[Math.floor(Math.random() * r.length)] }]);
      setTyping(false);
      setTimeout(() => setVis(p => ({ ...p, [bid]: true })), 50);
    }, 1400 + Math.random() * 900);
  };

  const avatarSize = mode === "chat" ? 100 : 260;
  const waveSize = mode === "chat" ? 140 : 340;

  return (
    <>
      <style>{`
        @import url('https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=DM+Sans:wght@400;500;600;700&family=Rajdhani:wght@500;600;700&family=Outfit:wght@300;400;500;600&display=swap');
        @keyframes fadeUp{from{opacity:0;transform:translateY(30px)}to{opacity:1;transform:translateY(0)}}
        @keyframes slideIn{from{opacity:0;transform:translateY(40px) scale(0.96)}to{opacity:1;transform:translateY(0) scale(1)}}
        @keyframes breathe{0%,100%{transform:translateY(0)}50%{transform:translateY(-8px)}}
        @keyframes shimmer{0%{background-position:-200% center}100%{background-position:200% center}}
        @keyframes ringGlow{0%,100%{box-shadow:0 0 20px rgba(0,212,255,0.15),0 0 50px rgba(123,47,190,0.08)}50%{box-shadow:0 0 35px rgba(0,212,255,0.3),0 0 80px rgba(123,47,190,0.15)}}
        @keyframes speakRing{0%,100%{box-shadow:0 0 25px rgba(229,35,48,0.2),0 0 60px rgba(230,138,0,0.12)}50%{box-shadow:0 0 40px rgba(229,35,48,0.4),0 0 80px rgba(230,138,0,0.25)}}
        @keyframes wakeZoom{0%{transform:scale(1);opacity:1}50%{transform:scale(1.1);opacity:1}100%{transform:scale(0.4);opacity:0}}
        @keyframes dotB{0%,80%,100%{transform:scale(0.5);opacity:0.2}40%{transform:scale(1);opacity:1}}
        @keyframes pFade{0%,100%{opacity:0}50%{opacity:0.7}}
        @keyframes bgSpin{from{transform:translate(-50%,-50%) rotate(0deg)}to{transform:translate(-50%,-50%) rotate(360deg)}}
        .ipF-in::placeholder{color:rgba(240,238,230,0.18)}
        .ipF-in:focus{outline:none;border-color:rgba(0,212,255,0.25);box-shadow:0 0 25px rgba(0,212,255,0.08)}
        .ipF-chip:hover{background:rgba(0,212,255,0.1)!important;border-color:rgba(0,212,255,0.4)!important;color:#f0eee6!important}
        .ipF-send:hover{background:${C.orangeGlow}!important;transform:scale(1.12);box-shadow:0 0 24px rgba(255,122,51,0.5)}
        .ipF-cta:hover{transform:scale(1.06)!important;box-shadow:0 8px 50px rgba(0,212,255,0.3),0 0 30px rgba(229,35,48,0.2)!important}
      `}</style>

      <div style={{width:"100vw",height:"100vh",background:`radial-gradient(ellipse at 50% 35%,#16102a,#0e0820 50%,${C.bg})`,display:"flex",flexDirection:"column",alignItems:"center",justifyContent:"center",position:"relative",overflow:"hidden",fontFamily:"'Outfit',sans-serif"}}>

        {/* BG ambient spin */}
        <div style={{position:"absolute",top:"50%",left:"50%",width:600,height:600,borderRadius:"50%",background:`conic-gradient(from 0deg,${C.cyan}04,${C.violet}06,${C.magenta}04,${C.orange}03,${C.cyan}04)`,animation:"bgSpin 25s linear infinite",filter:"blur(50px)",pointerEvents:"none",opacity:0.6}}/>

        {/* Bokeh */}
        {Array(20).fill(0).map((_,i)=>(<div key={i} style={{position:"absolute",left:`${5+Math.random()*90}%`,top:`${5+Math.random()*90}%`,width:2+Math.random()*4,height:2+Math.random()*4,borderRadius:"50%",background:[C.cyan,C.orangeGlow,C.violet,C.magenta,C.amber][i%5],opacity:0,animation:`pFade ${3+Math.random()*4}s ease-in-out ${Math.random()*6}s infinite`,filter:"blur(1px)",pointerEvents:"none"}}/>))}

        {/* ═══ LANDING ═══ */}
        {mode==="landing"&&(
          <div style={{display:"flex",flexDirection:"column",alignItems:"center",animation:"fadeUp 1s ease forwards",zIndex:2}}>
            {/* Avatar circle with wave ring */}
            <div style={{position:"relative",width:340,height:340,animation:"breathe 4s ease-in-out infinite"}}>
              <CircularWave speaking={false} idle={true} size={340}/>
              {/* Circle frame for avatar */}
              <div style={{position:"absolute",top:"50%",left:"50%",transform:"translate(-50%,-50%)",width:avatarSize,height:avatarSize,borderRadius:"50%",overflow:"hidden",border:"3px solid rgba(0,212,255,0.2)",animation:"ringGlow 3s ease-in-out infinite",zIndex:2}}>
                <img src={BOT_IMG} alt="InstaPass AI" style={{width:"100%",height:"100%",objectFit:"cover"}}/>
              </div>
            </div>

            {/* Horizontal wave */}
            <div style={{marginTop:-16}}>
              <SiriWave active={true} speaking={false} width={520} height={90}/>
            </div>

            {/* Title */}
            <div style={{textAlign:"center",marginTop:-4,zIndex:3}}>
              <h1 style={{fontFamily:"'Rajdhani',sans-serif",fontSize:38,fontWeight:700,color:C.text,margin:0,letterSpacing:4}}>
                <span style={{color:C.orange}}>INSTA</span>PASS<span style={{color:C.textMuted,fontWeight:500,fontSize:20,marginLeft:8}}>AI</span>
              </h1>
              <p style={{background:`linear-gradient(90deg,${C.cyan},${C.violet},${C.magenta},${C.cyan})`,backgroundSize:"200% auto",WebkitBackgroundClip:"text",WebkitTextFillColor:"transparent",animation:"shimmer 4s linear infinite",fontSize:12,letterSpacing:6,marginTop:4,fontWeight:500,textTransform:"uppercase"}}>Concierge</p>
              <p style={{color:C.textSoft,fontSize:12,marginTop:10,letterSpacing:2}}>Find events • Buy tickets • Discover fun</p>
            </div>

            <button className="ipF-cta" onClick={startChat} style={{marginTop:18,padding:"15px 52px",border:"1px solid rgba(0,212,255,0.15)",borderRadius:50,background:`linear-gradient(135deg,${C.orange},${C.red})`,color:"#fff",fontSize:14,fontWeight:600,fontFamily:"'Outfit',sans-serif",cursor:"pointer",letterSpacing:2,textTransform:"uppercase",boxShadow:`0 4px 35px ${C.orange}40`,transition:"all 0.3s ease"}}>Start Chatting</button>
          </div>
        )}

        {/* ═══ WAKING ═══ */}
        {mode==="waking"&&(
          <div style={{display:"flex",flexDirection:"column",alignItems:"center",zIndex:2}}>
            <div style={{position:"relative",width:300,height:300,animation:"wakeZoom 2.2s ease-in-out forwards"}}>
              <CircularWave speaking={true} idle={false} size={300}/>
              <div style={{position:"absolute",top:"50%",left:"50%",transform:"translate(-50%,-50%)",width:220,height:220,borderRadius:"50%",overflow:"hidden",border:"3px solid rgba(229,35,48,0.3)",zIndex:2}}>
                <img src={BOT_IMG} alt="" style={{width:"100%",height:"100%",objectFit:"cover"}}/>
              </div>
            </div>
            <SiriWave active={true} speaking={true} width={460} height={120}/>
            <p style={{color:C.textSoft,fontSize:14,letterSpacing:4,fontWeight:300,textTransform:"uppercase",animation:"fadeUp 0.6s ease 0.3s both"}}>Connecting...</p>
          </div>
        )}

        {/* ═══ CHAT ═══ */}
        {mode==="chat"&&(
          <div style={{display:"flex",flexDirection:"column",alignItems:"center",animation:"slideIn 0.6s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1) forwards",zIndex:10,width:440,maxWidth:"95vw"}}>

            {/* Avatar + circular wave */}
            <div style={{position:"relative",width:waveSize,height:waveSize,marginBottom:-20,zIndex:5}}>
              <CircularWave speaking={typing} idle={!typing} size={waveSize}/>
              <div style={{position:"absolute",top:"50%",left:"50%",transform:"translate(-50%,-50%)",width:avatarSize,height:avatarSize,borderRadius:"50%",overflow:"hidden",border:`2.5px solid ${typing?"rgba(229,35,48,0.35)":"rgba(0,212,255,0.15)"}`,animation:typing?"speakRing 0.7s ease-in-out infinite":"ringGlow 3s ease-in-out infinite",zIndex:2,transition:"border-color 0.3s"}}>
                <img src={BOT_IMG} alt="" style={{width:"100%",height:"100%",objectFit:"cover"}}/>
              </div>
            </div>

            {/* Horizontal wave */}
            <div style={{marginBottom:-8,zIndex:3}}>
              <SiriWave active={true} speaking={typing} width={400} height={50}/>
            </div>

            {/* Chat panel */}
            <div style={{width:"100%",height:420,maxHeight:"58vh",background:C.panel,borderRadius:24,border:"1px solid rgba(0,212,255,0.06)",display:"flex",flexDirection:"column",overflow:"hidden",boxShadow:"0 25px 80px rgba(0,0,0,0.7),0 0 40px rgba(0,212,255,0.03)"}}>

              {/* Chips */}
              <div style={{padding:"10px 16px",display:"flex",gap:6,flexWrap:"wrap",borderBottom:"1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.03)"}}>
                {["🎵 Concerts","😂 Comedy","🏀 Sports","🎭 Theater"].map(c=>(<button key={c} className="ipF-chip" onClick={()=>setInput(`Find ${c.slice(2).toLowerCase()} events near me`)} style={{padding:"5px 13px",borderRadius:20,background:"rgba(0,212,255,0.04)",border:"1px solid rgba(0,212,255,0.1)",color:C.textSoft,fontSize:11,cursor:"pointer",fontFamily:"'Outfit',sans-serif",transition:"all 0.25s",letterSpacing:0.3}}>{c}</button>))}
              </div>

              {/* Messages */}
              <div style={{flex:1,overflowY:"auto",padding:"14px 16px",display:"flex",flexDirection:"column"}}>
                {messages.map(m=>(<Bubble key={m.id} text={m.text} isBot={m.isBot} visible={!!vis[m.id]}/>))}
                {typing&&(<div style={{display:"flex",gap:5,padding:"10px 14px",width:"fit-content",borderRadius:"4px 16px 16px 16px",background:"rgba(0,212,255,0.04)",border:"1px solid rgba(0,212,255,0.08)"}}>
                  {[0,1,2].map(i=>(<div key={i} style={{width:6,height:6,borderRadius:"50%",background:C.cyan,animation:`dotB 1.4s ease-in-out ${i*0.2}s infinite`}}/>))}
                </div>)}
                <div ref={endRef}/>
              </div>

              {/* Input */}
              <div style={{padding:"12px 16px",borderTop:"1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.04)",background:"rgba(0,0,0,0.25)"}}>
                <div style={{display:"flex",gap:8,alignItems:"center"}}>
                  <button style={{width:36,height:36,borderRadius:"50%",background:"rgba(0,212,255,0.06)",border:"1px solid rgba(0,212,255,0.15)",color:C.cyan,fontSize:15,cursor:"pointer",display:"flex",alignItems:"center",justifyContent:"center",flexShrink:0,transition:"all 0.2s"}}>🎙</button>
                  <input className="ipF-in" type="text" value={input} onChange={e=>setInput(e.target.value)} onKeyDown={e=>e.key==="Enter"&&send()} placeholder="Ask about events, tickets, experiences..." style={{flex:1,padding:"10px 16px",borderRadius:22,background:"rgba(255,255,255,0.03)",border:"1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.06)",color:C.text,fontSize:13,fontFamily:"'Outfit',sans-serif",transition:"all 0.3s"}}/>
                  <button className="ipF-send" onClick={send} style={{width:36,height:36,borderRadius:"50%",background:C.orange,border:"none",color:"#fff",fontSize:14,cursor:"pointer",display:"flex",alignItems:"center",justifyContent:"center",flexShrink:0,transition:"all 0.2s",boxShadow:`0 2px 14px ${C.orange}40`}}>➤</button>
                </div>
                <div style={{textAlign:"center",marginTop:8,fontSize:8,color:C.textMuted,letterSpacing:2,textTransform:"uppercase"}}>Powered by InstaPass AI</div>
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>
        )}
      </div>
    </>
  );
}
